calls.statement:
SELECT 
  business_date,
  SUM(net_sales) as daily_net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as stores_with_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-08-31' AND business_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as trading_days,
  MIN(business_date) as first_date,
  MAX(business_date) as last_date
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date <= '2026-09-30'

SELECT SUM(net_sales) as net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
WHERE rds.business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND rds.business_date <= '2026-09-30'
